kit.state.empty.title: Empty (checked)
kit.state.empty.hint: The query ran and returned no records. This is a verified zero, not a failure.
kit.state.error.title: Could not load
kit.state.error.hint: This is not “empty”: the data was not received. Retry or check the connection.
kit.state.forbidden.title: No access
kit.state.forbidden.hint: The data is hidden by permissions — this is not “empty”.
kit.state.truncated.capped: Showing {shown}: the server cut the result at {limit} rows — narrow the query
kit.state.truncated.unknown: Showing {shown}: there is no way to check whether the result is complete
kit.state.truncated.unverified: 0 rows, but the requested fields could not be checked — this may be a typo, not missing data
